purpose: Predict whether a breach of the previous broker-day high/low is a failed auction followed by directional rejection.

data_authority.source_clock: Darwinex broker server clock; do not reinterpret as UTC during scoring
data_authority.execution_semantics: BUY Ask->Bid; SELL Bid->Ask; crossed quotes invalid; zero spread preserved but no artificial advantage.

structural_levels.reason: Keep v1 causally narrow and interpretable; other level families are descendants, not silent additions.

event_definition.bearish_failed_auction: Executable market breaches previous-day high, reaches an extreme, then reclaims below the level within max_dwell_seconds.
event_definition.bullish_failed_auction: Executable market breaches previous-day low, reaches an extreme, then reclaims above the level within max_dwell_seconds.
event_definition.atr: ATR14 from completed M15 bars only

micro_reversal.formula: directional signed-mid-tick imbalance over last 32 valid mid-price changes, mapped to [0,1]

score: 0..100; direction is stored separately. No fitted weights in v1.

prediction_contract.ambiguity: SL first if SL and target are first reachable at the same timestamp/bar granularity

primary_statistical_test.null: High-score events have no better target-before-stop probability than all eligible failed-auction events.
effect_requirements: score-bin hit rate is directionally monotone across [0-40), [40-55), [55-70), [70-85), [85-100]
primary_statistical_test.multiplicity: All predeclared score thresholds/bins counted; no post-hoc threshold substitution.

PASS: combined result not used to hide a failing side
gate_a_for_indicator.FAIL: No threshold rescue after seeing results. New rule => descendant campaign.

portfolio_rule: Even if predictive Gate A passes, portfolio inclusion requires later marginal-correlation and overlap analysis versus XAU M1-M4.
forbidden: changing score threshold after outcomes are seen
treating M5/M15 proxy data as parity with canonical ticks
